definitions.gloss: carrying in; bringing in; delivery (of goods or equipment)
definitions.explanation: The act of transporting goods, equipment, or materials into a building, venue, or designated area. Used in logistics, event planning, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機材|きざい}→機材：13187_kizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{搬入|はんにゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Equipment delivery will be done in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{展示品|てんじひん}→展示品：19234_tenjihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{搬入|はんにゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The delivery of the exhibition items is running behind schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦{前日|ぜんじつ}→前日：03108_zenjitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{搬入|はんにゅう}し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二台|にだい}⟦{手配|てはい}→手配：07604_tehai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since we need to bring a large amount of cargo into the venue the day before the event, we arranged for two trucks.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Common in business, logistics, and event planning. The opposite is ⟦{搬出|はんしゅつ}→搬出：16611_hanshutsu⟧ (carrying out, removal).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {搬入|はんにゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to carry in, to deliver)
- {搬入|はんにゅう}{口|ぐち} (delivery entrance)
- {搬入|はんにゅう}⟦{経路|けいろ}→経路：13796_keiro⟧ (delivery route)
- {搬入|はんにゅう}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (loading-in work)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{搬出|はんしゅつ}→搬出：16611_hanshutsu⟧: carrying out — the opposite action of removing goods from a location
- ⟦{納品|のうひん}→納品：05134_nouhin⟧: delivery of goods — specifically delivering ordered merchandise to a client
